tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i lha gsum las/ khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs ni gnyis lhag rgyal ba'i phyag dang rig byed zhal dang zhabs gnyis pa// dmar ser spyan dang dbu skra dmar ser rgyal ba'i bdag po'i cod pan mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa ste// sbrul gyi rgyan dang rab mchog stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang ni gtso bo'i bzhin du mtshon cha'i phyag /spyi bor mtha' dag rgyal ba'i rigs kyi thod pa kha dog lnga rnams dag gi phreng ba nges par bcings// dri med 'od zer 'phro ba sna tshogs chu skyes nyi ma'i steng du dkyil 'khor sna tshogs mdog la ni// zhabs gnyis dag gis 'byung po'i mgon po lhag pa'i stabs kyis mnan cing g.yas brkyang stabs kyis yang dag gnas// 'byung po rnams dang lha min gdengs can lha rnams skrag par byed cing ye shes sems dpa' gcig gyur pa// bsgoms na zla ba gcig nyid kho nas dur khrod sa la gnas pa 'byung po'i tshogs ni bsgrub par bya/

135 /klu rnams chu skyes 'dab brgyad la ste rgyal dang rnam rgyal dag ni nyi ma'i steng du bsgyel byas nas// zhabs dag gis ni gdengs can bdag po zung dang pad+ma'i 'dab mar gnas pa rnams kyi mjug ma yi// rtse mo thams cad mnan nas sprin gyi rigs ni lto ba dag nas nges par kun tu spro byed pa// de ltar khro bo'i dbang po bsgoms pas nyin zhag 'ga' zhig dag gis sprin gyi tshogs ni bsgrub par bya/ 136 /zhes bya ba ni bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi sgrub thabs kyi le'u las so// ༈ /gnas pa bzhi pa/ 'byung po la sogs pa rnams kyi/ /rje bo dngos po sna tshogs mi 'gyur ba'i bde bar ro gcig tu gyur pa rnam par rtogs pas dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje 'dzin// khro bo'i drang don du phrin las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso// rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal nas// sgrub pa sna tshogs bshad par bya// khro bo'i dbang po zhes pa la sogs pas so// 'dir khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs ni sngar gsungs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi cho gas hūm̐ yig las rdzogs pa gnyis lhag rgyal ba'i phyag ces pa phyag nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ glang po che'i pags pa'i gos 'dzin pa/ rig byed zhal zhes pa zhal bzhi pa zhabs gnyis pa/ dmar ser spyan dang dbu skra dmar ser rgyal ba'i bdag po'i cod pan zhes pa mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa/ sbrul gyi rgyan dang zhes pa sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rab mchog stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gtso bo'i bzhin du mtshon cha'i phyag ste dus kyi 'khor lo lta bu/ spyi bor mtha' dag rgyal ba'i rigs rnam par dag pa'i thod pa kha dog lnga rnams dag gi phreng ba nges par bcings pa/ de ltar gyur pa dri med 'od zer 'phro ba ste dang ba ni sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa sna tshogs mdog la dbus su dpa' bo gcig pa ste/

sgo bzhi rnams su rdo rje dang lcags kyu dang rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ rdo rje dril bu rnams go rim ji lta ba bzhin bkod nas/ zhabs gnyis dag gis 'byung po'i mgon po ste yi dwags kyi mgon po gzhan gyis mi thub pa lhag pa'i stabs kyis mnan cing g.yas brkyang stabs kyis yang dag gnas pa/ 'byung po la sogs pa rnams skrag par byed pa'i glang po che'i pags pa 'dzin pa/ lag pa'i sdigs mdzub dag gis lha min gdengs ka can lha rnams skrag par byed pa/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsngags kyi tshig 'di dag gis ye shes sems dpa' dang lhan cig tu gyur pa rnal 'byor pas bsgoms na zla ba gcig nyid kho nas dur khrod sa la gnas pa zhes pa/ dur khrod kyi sar gnas pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs ni bsgrub par bya zhes pa ste 'byung po la sogs pa rnams kyi gtso bo gang yin pa de gzugs des zhabs kyi 'og tu bsgyel bar gyur pa na/ 'khor dang bcas pa 'grub par 'gyur te/ yi dwags sam srin po la sogs pa'o// 'byung po la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi nges pa'o// da ni sprin gyi char dbab pa'i don du klu'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs gsungs pa/ klu rnams zhes pa la sogs pa ste 'dir khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs de nyid bsgoms par gyur pas nyin zhag 'ga' zhig dag gis zhes pa zla ba'i nyin zhag rnams kyis sprin gyi tshogs ni bsgrub par bya ste/ de ltar zhes pa cho ga 'di yis so// klu rnams chu skyes 'dab brgyad la ste zhes pa ni chu skyes kyi shar gyi 'dab ma la stobs kyi rgyu'o// mer pad+ma'o// lhor nor rgyas kyi bu'o// bden bral du dung skyong ngo*// byang du mtha' yas so// dbang ldan du rigs ldan no// nub tu 'jog po'o// rlung du pad+ma chen po'o// shar dang mer nag po dag go /lho dang bden bral du dmar po dang nag po dag go /byang dang dbang ldan du dkar po dag go

/nub dang rlung du ser po dag go /klu'i rgyal po rgyal ba dang rnam rgyal ljang gu dang sngon po dag ni nyi ma'i steng du bsgyel byas nas zhes pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i zhabs kyi 'og tu/ lte ba yan chad skyes bu'i rnam pa/ man chad sbrul gyi rnam pa/ mgo bo'i steng na gdengs ka bdun gyis khor yug can nor bu chen po'i 'od 'phro ba dag gan rkyal du bsgyel zhing*/ klu'i rgyal po gzhan rnams bsgyel nas/ de rnams kyi mjug ma'i rtse mo ni so sor rgyal ba'i steng du shar dang byang gi rnams dang*/ rnam par rgyal ba'i steng du lho dang nub kyi rnams kyi mjug ma'i rtse mo thams cad do// de ltar zhabs dag gis ni gdengs can bdag po zung dang pad+ma'i 'dab mar gnas pa rnams kyi mjug ma yi/ rtse mo thams cad mnan nas zhes so// de ltar klu'i rgyal po brgyad ni gdengs ka lnga dang ldan pa sprin gyi rigs te sprin tshogs lto ba dag nas nges par kun tu spro byed pa'o// de ltar dur khrod kyi sar khro bo'i dbang po bsgoms pas zla ba'i nyin zhag rnams kyi sprin tshogs ni bsgrub par bya ste/ de nas ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i dus su char 'bebs par byed cing*/ gshegs su gsol bas zlog par byed do// klu'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs kyi nges pa'o// zhes bya ba ni 'grel chen dri ma med pa'i 'od las so// ༈ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i lha gsum gyi nang nas rdo rje shugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥshrī kā la tsakrā ya/ 'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong gi las sgrub pa'i lha gsum gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs bsgom par 'dod pas gnas dben par stan bde ba la 'khod de skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi dang bcas pa spyi dang mthun pa sngon du btang*/

oṃ shū n+yā ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las ham̐ las nam mkha'i rang bzhin chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang du/ yam̐ las rlung dkyil nag po/ ram̐ las me dkyil dmar po/ bam̐ las chu dkyil dkar po/ lam̐ las sa dkyil ser po rnams re re bzhin steng 'og tu hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje kha sbyar gyis brgyan pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las rdo rje'i rwa ba'i dbus na/ oṃ hūm̐ bi shwa kā ya badz+ra kū ṭā ga raṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i dbus su khang brtsegs steng 'og tu khru nyis brgya pa'i dbus su/ oṃ pam̐ bi shu badz+ra pad+mam̐ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa khru bcu gnyis pa lte ba la khri bzhi yod pa'i lte ba'i steng du/ oṃ raḥbadz+ra sūr+ya ā sa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lte ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du rang nyid hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje shugs sku mdog sngon po dbus gnag g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba'i mgrin pa gsum dang ldan pa/ sngo dmar ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi re re'ang mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dmar ser du 'dug pa dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ g.yas g.yon gyi phrag pa gsum nag dmar dkar ba/ kha dog de dang mtshungs pa'i dpung pa drug drug phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ phyag lhag ma gnyis g.yas nag g.yon ser ba/ phyag rnams kyi mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ ming med nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang gu/ sor mo rnams kyi tshigs phreng dang po nag po gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po sor gdub rnams kyis mdzes shing 'od 'phro ba/ zhabs g.yas dmar po g.yon dkar pos bdud dang 'dod lha dang*/ nyon mongs pa dbang phyug gi snying gar g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis mnan pa/ sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/

mgo bo dang thod pa'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ phrag par bdud rigs brgya'i mgo bo'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ dbu re re la thod pa rdzogs pa kha dog lnga'i phreng ba/ g.yas kyi phyag nag po bzhi'i dang por khro bo'i rdo rje/ gnyis par rdo rje ral gri/ gsum par rdo rje rtse gsum/ bzhi par rdo rje gri gug dmar po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje mda'/ gnyis par rdo rje lcags kyu/ gsum par rdo rje cang te'u/ bzhi par rdo rje tho ba/ dkar po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje 'khor lo/ gnyis par rdo rje mdung*/ gsum par rdo rje dbyug pa/ bzhi par rdo rje dgra s+t+wa'o// g.yon gyi nag po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje dril bu/ gnyis par rdo rje phub/ gsum par rdo rje kha ṭ+wām̐ ga bzhi par rdo rje thod pa/ dmar po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje gzhu/ gnyis par rdo rje zhags pa/ gsum par rdo rje rin po che/ bzhi par rdo rje pad+ma/ dkar po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje dung*/ gnyis par rdo rje me long*/ gsum par rdo rje lcags sgrog bzhi par tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa'i mgo bo/ glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa/ mgo bo g.yas su bstan te gyon pa'i rkang lag g.yon pa gnyis nas phyag lhag ma gnyis kyis bzung ste 'phyar zhing sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa/ klu rgyal ba ljang gus ral pa'i cod pan du bcings shing*/ rnam rgyal sngon pos dar dpyangs su bcings pa/ stobs rgyu dang pad+ma nag pos g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag la brgyan pa/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po dag gis g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i lag gdub byas pa/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar po dag gis ska rags dang mgul ba brgyan pa/ 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po ser po dag gis g.yon dang g.yas pa'i rkang gdub byas pa/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ

gtsug tor du haṃ/ gsang gnas su k+ṣaḥ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhiḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa ro mnyam/ oṃ ā ī ṝ ū l̥̄ pañtsa dhā tu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ dbang bskur mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ lā s+yaṃ/ hā s+yaṃ/ bā d+yaṃ/ nṛ taṃ/ gī ti/ kā maṃ/ pū dzaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed// dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po// dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can// khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal// zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon la sngags phreng gis bskor bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥham̐ k+ṣa badz+ra bi ga hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzla/ oṃ hūm̐ kro dhe na dro3 haṃ/ kro dha nāṃ/ ā dzña dā ya ka swā hā/ zhes pa'ang khro bo rnams bskul ba'i don du bzla zhing*/ oṃ a ra ra ra ra la la la la/ badz+ra ā be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pa'ang ye shes dbab pa'i don du bzla bar bshad la/ gtso bor phreng sngags rkang pa bcu drug pa dang*/ bdun cu pa bzla thub na 'di'i sngags kyi gtso bo yin no// bzlas pa'i mthar dge ba bsngos la/ gtor ma 'bul bar spro na skabs 'dir bya'o// 'di ni mngon rtogs bsdus pa'i lugs te/ rgyas par dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung 'khor rgyas 'bring kho na ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o// rdo rje shugs kyi rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad ljang gu bris pa'i lte bar nyi zla sgra gcan mtshon pa'i gdan dmar dkar nag gsum brtsegs pa la tshom bu ljang gu gcig dgod/ de'i khar mañdzi'i khar gtor ma zlum po dbal can tsakli dang bcas pa 'god/ de'i mthar chu bzhi dang shar du dri chab dang me tog lhor spos dang mar me/ byang du lha bshos dang shing tog nub tu dbu rgyan dang do shal/ shar gyi shar du/ steng gi ro la sgra ma'i ting shag dang gar ma'i gos zung*/

nub kyi nub tu 'og gi mchod pa rdo rje dang pad+ma rnams dngos sam bris pa bsham/ 'bul gtor bdun nam/ kha gso'i theb kyu dang bcas pa mdun phyogs su bsgrigs/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod/ rdor dril/ cang te'u/ me tog 'thor 'bru sogs tshang bar byas la/ nang mchod oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥs byin gyis brlab/ mchod pa rnams la nang mchod gtor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣa/ zhes pas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las s+pham̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che shel las grub ba'i mchod snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ aṃ las mchod yon/ pām̐ las zhabs bsil/ praṃ las bsang gtor/ aṃ las zhal bsil/ puṃ las me tog bh+rūm̐ las bdug spos/ dīṃ las mar me/ naiṃ las zhal zas/ aṃ las 'bras bu ma nyams pa/ lāṃ las sgeg mo/ hūm̐ las bzhad ma/ bāṃ las rol mo/ nriṃ las gar ma/ gīṃ las glu ma/ kāṃ las 'dod ma la sogs pa mchod rdzas thams cad dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ nam mkha' dang bar snang sa gzhi thams cad khyab par ngo bo stong pa nyid rnam pa so sor snang ba/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed par byed pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po la sogs pa'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang khro bo rdo rje shugs srung ma drug cu dang bcas pa thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ añtsa mā naṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du gan+dhaṃ sogs bcu gnyis la/ pra tīts+tsha swā hā sbyar ba brjod de byin gyis brlab/ skyabs sems nas bzlas pa'i bar sngar bzhin nyams su blang*/ de nas mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ham̐ las nam mkha'i rang bzhin sogs nas/

ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin las rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ ha hā las gtsug tor can ljang gu dang gnod mdzes sngon po/ yi yī las bgegs mthar byed dang dbyug sngon can nag po/ raṛ raṝ las shes rab mthar byed dang 'dod rgyal dmar po/ wu wū las pad+ma mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba dkar po/ ll̥ ll̥̄ las gshin rje mthar byed dang stobs po che ser po ste khro bo bcu dang*/ nga ngā las zad par nam mkha' ljang khu dang sngon po// nyi nyī las zad par rlung gnyis nag po/ ṇaṛ ṇarī zad par me gnyis dmar po/ mu mū las zad par chu gnyis dkar po/ nal̥ nal̥̄ las zad par sa gnyis ser po ste zad par bcu dang*/ gha ghā las tshangs pa ljang gu dang khyab 'jug sngon po/ dzhi dzhī las bden bral dang rlung lha nag po/ dhṛ dh+ṝ las gshin rje dang me lha dmar po/ bhu bhū las chu lha dang drag po dkar po/ dhala'-i dhala'-i las dbang po dang gnod sbyin ser po ste phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ ga gā las sgra can ljang gu dang dus me sngon po/ dzi dzī las zla ba dang nyi ma nag po/ ḍṛ ḍ+ṝ las lhag pa dang mig dmar po/ bu bū las pa sangs dang phur bu dkar po/ r+y-i r+y-i las mjug ring dang spen pa ser po ste gza' bcu dang*/ kha khā las rgyal ba ljang gu dang rnam rgyal sngon po/ tshi tshī las stobs rgyu dang pad+ma nag po/ ṭhṛ ṭh+ṝ las nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po/ phu phū las mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar po/ thil thilā las pad+ma chen po dang 'jog po ser po ste klu bcu dang*/ ka kā las ro langs ljang gu dang grul bum sngon po/ tsi tsī las khyi gdong can dang bya rog gdong can nag po/ ḍṛ ḍ+ṝ las phag gdong can dang bya rgod gdong can dmar po/ pu pū las stag gdong can dang 'ug gdong can dkar po/ t-il t-il las ce spyang gdong can dang mkha' lding gdong can ser po ste 'byung po bcu dang bcas pa'i sde drug srung ma drug cu'i tshogs rnams pad 'dab kyi nang nas rim bzhin steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod par gyur/
rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra bhai ra ba ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ gan+dhaṃ

dri rgya sogs/ sogs kyis mchod/ pradzñān+ta ka hūm̐/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i rgya/ ya mān+ta ka baṃ/ zhags pa'i rgya/ pad+mān+ta ka hoḥ dril bu'i rgya/ bigh+nān+ta ka ham̐/ dbyug pa'i rgya/ dam tshig pa rnams la ye shes pa ro mnyam/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gtsug tor tu haṃ/ gsang bar k+ṣaḥ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gan+dhaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ āḥ.ī ṝ ū l̥̄ pañtsa dhā tu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes dbang bskur/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ oṃ kā mam̐ pra trīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis chu bzhi dang lha mo bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥbadz+ra bhai ra wa/ ha ya ra wa la/ nga nya ṇa ma na/ bha dzha ḍha bha dha/ ga dza ḍa bha ra/ kha tsha ṭha pha tha/ ka tsa ṭa pa ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥn maḥ zhes nang mchod phul/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed// dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po// dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can// khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal// rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin// khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso// rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal zhing*// srung ma drug cu'i tshogs la 'dud// ces bstod/ gtor ma chang chu nang mchod kyi bran/ oṃ phraiṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba dra bya bi sho dha ni/ sarba dra byā ṇi bi shwa dhā ya hūm̐ phreṃ phaṭ kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa'i nang du sha lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ phyag rgya bzhi bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i/ phyag rgyas gtso bo khro bo rnams dang*/ gri gug gi phyag rgyas zad par dang*/

ral gri'i phyag rgyas phyogs skyong dang*/ rin po che'i phyag rgyas gza' dang*/ pad+ma'i phyag rgyas klu dang*/ 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas 'byung po rnams spyan drangs shing*/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyi 'od zer gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ rdo rje'i rgya/ āḥhūm̐ ho shrī kā la tsakra badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te tsā ga t+ya sa pa ri wā rāḥ shī gh+raṃ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan tu/ khā dan+tu/ pi ban+tu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ saṃ trib+tāḥ sarba satwā nāṃ/ shān+tiṃ/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ rak+ṣa a ba ra ṇa/ gubhi kurban+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ badz+ra dha ra ādzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ āḥ rdo rje'i rgya/ hūm̐ hoḥ.uṣ+ṇi ṣa sum+bha ni sum+bha/ bigh+nān+ta ka nī la daṇ+ḍa/ pra dzñān+ta ka ṭāk+ki rā dza/ pad+mān+ta ka a tsa la/ ya mān+ta ka ma hā ba le bh+yaḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ gri gug rgya/ āḥhūm̐ ho ā kā sha bā yu/ te dza/ u da ka pṛ thi wī sā dhi te bh+yaḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥ ral gri'i rgya/ hūm̐ hoḥ brah+ma/ biṣ+ṇu/ nai ḍṛ t+ya/ bā yu/ ya ma/ ag+ni/ sa mu dri/ ī shwa ren+d+ra/ yak+ṣe bh+yaḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥ rin po che'i rgya/ hūm̐ ho rā hu/ kā la/ ag+ni/ tsan+d+ra/ sūr+ya/ bud+dha/ maṃ ga la/ shu kra/ bṛ haspa ti kṛṣ+ṇa/ wār+ṇaṇa ke tu sha ni bh+yaḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ pad+ma'i rgya/ āḥhūm̐ ho dza ya/ bi dza ya/ pad+ma/ karko ṭa ka bā su ki shaṃ kha pā la/ ku le ka a nan+ta/ taṃk+ṣa ka ma hā pad+me bh+yaḥ zhes dang*/ 'khor lo'i rgya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho be tā ḍa bi kri ta mu kha/ shu na/ kā ka sū ka ra/ ghṛ ḍha/ byā gh+ra ū lu ka dzi bu ka gu ru ḍa mu khe bh+yaḥ zhes pa'i sde tshan re re'i mthar/ sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ sogs btags pa tshar gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥnas 'byung po'i sngags kyi bar sbrel ba'i mthar/

sa pa ri wā re man chad btags pa tshar gcig gnyis kyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra badz+ra bhi ra wā ya na maḥ de bzhin du/ oṃ uṣ+ṇī ṣa sum+bha ni sum+bha sogs/ sde tshan re re'i mgor oṃ dang mthar na maḥ sbyar ba'i nang mchod g.yon gyi mtheb srin gyis 'bul/ ḍā dril dang bcas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed nas 'dud/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ gtsug tor gnod mdzes nges gnod mdzes// bgegs mthar byed dang dbyug pa sngo// shes rab mthar byed 'dod pa'i rgyal// pad+ma mthar byed mi g.yo ba// gshin rje mthar byed stobs chen rnams// nam mkha' rlung dang me dang chu// sa yi zad par grub pa rnams// tshangs pa khyab 'jug bden bral rlung*// gshin rje me dang rgya mtsho dang*// drag po dbang po gnod sbyin rnams// sgra gcan dus me zla nyi ma// lhag pa bkra shis khu ba dang*// phur bu mjug ring dal 'gro rnams// rgyal ba rnams rgyal pad stobs rgyu// nor rgyas dung skyong rigs ldan dang*// mtha' yas 'jog po pad chen rnams// ro langs rnam par 'gyur zhal khyi// bya rog phag dang bya rgod stag /'ug pa lce spyang khyung gdong rnams// 'khor dang bcas la gtor ma dri// me tog bdug pa sgron ma dang*// ma nyams pa 'di bdag 'bul gyi// 'khor bcas de rnams kyang byon la// myur du gtor ma 'di gzung mdzod// gsol bar mdzod cig btung bar mdzod// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥyang dag tshims// sems can kun la zhi ba dang*// rgyas dang srung dang bskyab pa dang*// sba bar mdzod cig hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa// rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bsgos mdzod// swā hā/ zhes brjod cing gtor ma 'bul/ de nas mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci 'grub byas la/ mthar bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag dang slob ma rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// slob ma rnams khrus phyag sngon 'gro'i snyim pa me tog dang bcas gral la 'khod/

slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu snyam du sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la gsan par bya ba'i chos ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i thun mong gi las sna tshogs pa sgrub pa'i lha gsum du grags pa'i nang nas 'dir skabs su babs pa bgegs dang bar chad thams cad srung zhing las thams cad la bsngags pa khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje shugs sde drug srung ma drug cu dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad nye bar grub zin pa yin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa rnams yin pas/ slob dpon yang khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje shugs tha mi dad pa la rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod pa dang slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas slob dpon dang*/ mdun gyi rten rnams kyang khro bo rdo rje shugs srung ma drug cus bskor ba dngos su mos te/ de dag gi mdun du khyed rang rnams 'khod nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de ring nyid nas mi bzad 'khor bas 'jigs pa dag ni rgyal ba rnams la skyabs su lhag par mchi// khyod kyi zhabs kyi chu skyes nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog dag la lus ngag sems ni dag pas so// zhes lan gsum/ de nas rgyun bshags bya ba'i slad du mdun gyi rten rdo rje shugs srung ma drug cus bskor ba'i steng gi nam mkha' la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad sprin phung 'khrigs pa bzhin du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bgyi snyam du tshig don dran pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas sdig pa rnam pa mang po bsags pa dag ni bshags par bgyi// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang mdzad pa// de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnam bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pas rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dag pa gsum gyis bdag gi dngos 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo skor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do// zhes lan gsum bya/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs drug gi sdom pa bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma dag kyang spyi bos bzung bar bgyi// rin chen la ni sbyin pa sbyin bgyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyang bar bgyi// ral gri la ni mchod pa bgyi ste gsal bar chu skyes rigs las sdom pa dag ni bskyang bar bgyi// sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba bskyed mdzad rigs la byang chub bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// zhes lan gsum bya/ de nas rjes gnang dngos la thog mar lus ngag yid ye shes sbyang ba/ bdud dang bgegs sbyang ba rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ de la bdud rtsi myang bas lus sems bde bas gang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes nang mchod kyi bdud rtsi byin/ khyed rang rnams kyi gtsug tor gyi steng du wam̐ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug yongs su rdzogs pa gsal lam gyi byung ba'i mos pa mdzad nas/ slob dpon gyis mchog gi phyag rgyas lus kyi stod smad bar gsum du reg cing sngags brjod nas lus ngag yid ye shes dag ldan du byas par sgoms mdzod/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ pradzño pā ya āt+ma ka kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dzñā na a dhi pa ti ma ma kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dzñā na bidz+ra badz+rā mṛ ta swa bhā baṃ ku ru ku ru skan+dha dhā twā ya ta naṃ niḥswa bhā waṃ swā hā/ gsum/ des gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi bar khyed rang gi lus sbrul shun pa brjes pa bzhin du lan gsum dor te/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur par bsgoms te pad kor sngon 'gro'i 'khyud rgya dang bcas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar po la oṃ dkar po las rdo rje dkar po rtse mo bcu bdun pa/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po la āḥdamar po las rdo rje dmar po rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor nag po la hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse mo dgu pa/ lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor ser po la hoḥlas rdo rje ser po rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa/ gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ljang gu la haṃ ljang gu las rdo rje ljang gu rtse mo lnga pa/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor sngon po la k+ṣaḥlas rdo rje sngon po rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ tshigs chen bcu gnyis dang lag sor dang rkang sor gyi tshigs rnams su rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa bcu gnyis dang rtse mo bdun pa drug cu/ dbang po dang las dbang rnams la rdo rje rtse gsum pa drug dang*/ rtse lnga pa lnga bkod nas khyed rang rnams kyi lus rdo rje'i skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar bkod pa'i rdo rje de rnams las rang rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i me rab tu 'bar ba 'phros te/ steng du ljang gu/ 'og tu sngon po/ shar dang shar lho gnag lho dang lho nub dmar/ byang dang byang shar dkar/

nub dang nub byang ser ba'i rdo rje 'bar ba rnams kyis phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i bdud kyi tshogs sems can la rnam par 'tshe bar byed pa rnams nges par sregs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥhrāḥhrāḥhrāḥr ra ra ra badz+ra ā na la sarba ā wa ra ṇa dharma pra la ya swa bha wa sarba mā ra kā yi ka bigh+rāṃ bi nā ya kā dī naṃ da sha di ga tā nāṃ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta ni da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa bha smī ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ bgegs kyi lus ngag yid gsum bsregs nas thal bar gyur/ de dag gi sbyang ba rnams grub zin nas rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa'i slad du khyod rang rnams kyis slob dpon dang mdun bskyed rdo rje shugs sde drug srung ma drug cu'i tshogs dang bcas pa la mos gus dung par byas pas/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pa tsam gyis sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bu chen por gyur pa la slob dpon gyis oṃ swa bhā wa nas shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams kyi go sar/ oṃ pam̐ bi shwa badz+ra pad+mam̐ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas pad+ma dang 'dab ma brgyad pa de'i lte ba'i steng du/ oṃ raḥbadz+ra sūr+ya ā sa naṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lte ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du khyed rang rnams hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje shugs sku mdog sngon po nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhrī/

slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gan+dhaṃ sogs/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ yum rnams kyis/ oṃ ā ī ṝ ā lī pañtsa dhā tu bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rjes gnang dngos la sku gsung thugs ye shes phrin las kyi rjes gnang dang lnga las dang po sku'i rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed khro bo rdo rje shugs su gsal ba'i dpral ba nas klu bcu dang*/ 'byung po bcu dpag tu med pa spros nas khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim pas lus kyi bar chad thams cad dag lus kyi khams srung ba la dbang zhing*/ sku'i rjes gnang thob/ lus sku rdo rje'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags brjod cing rol mo bya ba'i 'og tu 'gre/ yang mgrin pa nas phyogs skyong bcu dang gza' bcu dpag tu med pa spros nas khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas ngag gi bar chad thams cad dag ngag gi khams srung ba la dbang zhing*/ gsung gi rjes gnang thob/ ngag gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa chad/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzad nas sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho ham̐ k+ṣa badz+ra bi ga hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar gsum/ de bzhin du oṃ hūm̐ kro dhe na dro3haṃ/ kro dha naṃ ā dzñā dā ya ka swā hā/ zhes dang*/

oṃ a ra ra ra ra la la la la badz+ra ā be sha ya hūm̐/ byin gyis brlab ba'i lung gi don du slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ de ltar khyed rang rnams kyi me tog phul ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te spyi bor gtad pas sngags kyi dngos grub myur du 'grub pa dang byin rlabs brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la khro bo rdo rje shugs sde drug srung ma drug cu dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig dam bca' ba'i slad du dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du khro bo rdo rje shugs yi dam du bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bgyi pas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ khro bo rdo rje shugs sde drug srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ yang thugs ka nas zad par bcu dang*/ khro bo bcu dpag tu med pa spros nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas yid kyi bar chad thams cad dag yid kyi khams srung ba la dbang zhing*/ thugs kyi rjes gnang thob/ yid thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang lte ba nas khro bo rdo rje shugs kyi sku che chung ma nges pa dpag tu med pa spros nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte bar thim pas ye shes kyi bar chad thams cad dag ye shes kyi khams srung ba la dbang zhing*/ ye shes kyi rjes gnang thob/

ma dag pa'i ye shes dag pa ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol bya ba sngar bzhin no// de rnams kyi sgo nas khro bo rdo rje shugs kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang rang nyid lhar sgom zhing nus ldan du bya ba'i rim pa grub/ da gzhan don phrin las kyi rjes gnang la/ gtor ma 'di nyid khro rgyal rdo rje shugs su gsal ba'i steng du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sde dang bcas pa khra lam me dngos su bzhugs pa la/ khyed rang rnams kyis mos gus dung par mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis spyi bor yer gyis byon/ de rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi 'od zer sna lnga dang bcas pa'i rgyun byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad lhag ma med par sbyangs/ tshe dang bsod nams dang lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad/ mthar 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas/ rang nyid khro bo rdo rje shugs dngos su gyur te zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las rab 'byams sgrub pa la nus mthu thogs pa med pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo/ gsang bdag zla bzang*/ lha dbang*/ gzi brjid can/ zla bas byin/ lha'i dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/ lha'i dbang ldan/ rigs ldan 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ pad+ma dkar po/ dus zhabs pa/ na lan+d+ra pa/ kha che zla mgon/ 'bro lo tsā ba shes rab grags/ sgom pa dkon mchog srung*/ sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ yu mo mi bskyod rdo rje/ sras chos kyi dbang phyug grub thob nam mkha' 'od zer/ ma gcig sprul sku jo 'bum/ se mo che nam mkha' 'od/ 'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ kun spang thugs rje brtson 'grus/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/

mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang ma te paṇa chen/ jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ nya dpon kun dga' dpal/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po/ zhwa lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang po/ byang pa lo tsā ba dkon mchog bzang po/ lo chen 'gyur med bde chen/ rje a ba dhū ti pa chen po/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ chos rje kun dga' rnam rgyal/ byams pa nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ mchog sprul nam mkha' legs 'byung*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje'i slob dpon bsod nams phun tshogs dpal bzang po'i bar du brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ khyad par du'ang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo khro bo'i dbang po'i skur bstan pa rdo rje shugs kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas rdo rje slob ma 'di'i bdud dang log 'dren 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi bar gcod thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol lo// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhī/ zhes gtor ma'i lha tshogs slob ma'i spyi bor bstim mo// de ltar rjes gnang zab mo thob pa'i dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams bsrung ngo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs dang gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba man dkyus bzhin no// rjes mdun bskyed la mchod bstod bzod gsol byas la/ gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo'i ham̐ la khro bo rnams gshegs/ gtsug tor gyi aṃ la zad par rnams gshegs/ dpral ba'i i la phyogs skyong rnams gshegs/ mgrin pa'i ṛ la gza' rnams=

snying ga'i u la klu rnams= lte ba'i l̥ la 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ zhes brjod cing bsngo smon shis brjod bya ste/ rjes gnang gi bya thabs bstan zin to// 'di'i las tshogs la char 'bebs pa/ thog ser srung ba/ lus srung gi 'khor lo bya thabs rnams las/ dang po char dbab par 'dod na pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la rang nyid rdo rje shugs sngar bshad pa bzhin bskyed la de'i zhabs g.yon pa'i 'og tu klu rgyal ba ljang gu dang g.yas pa'i 'og tu rnam rgyal sngon po lte ba yan chad mi'i rnam pa smad sprul gyi rnam par 'dug pa sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun gyi khor yug can/ nor bu chen po 'od 'phro bas brgyan pa gan rkyal du bsgyel ba dang*/ shar shar lho'i pad 'dab la stobs rgyu dang pad+ma nag po/ lho lho nub kyi pad 'dab la nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po/ byang byang shar gyi pad 'dab la mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar po/ nub nub byang gi pad 'dab la 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po ser po rnams kyi mjug ma'i rtse mo shar nas byang du bskor ba bzhi rgyal ba'i steng dang*/ lho nas nub tu bskor ba bzhi rnam par rgyal ba'i steng du zugs te mjug rtse thams cad zhabs 'og tu bcug cing bsgyel nas mnan pa'o// pad 'dab la gnas pa'i klu brgyad gdengs ka lnga dang ldan pa gan rkyal du nyal ba'i lto ba nas sprin gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa kun tu spro bar byed pa la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad la/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra ādzña war+ṣa naṃ sā dhā ya swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥbadz+ra bi ga huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yul che ge mor klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis char chen po phob cig swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing thun bzhir bcang la bsnyen pa bya ste/ rgyud las dur khrod du bsgom par gsungs so// rnal 'byor pa dbang po rab tu gyur nas ting nge 'dzin dang sngags kyi sbyor ba de tsam kho nas kyang don 'grub bo// gal te des kyang char 'bebs dka' na klu mthu bo che gnas pa'i sar phyin la/

dur khrod kyis las byas pa'i stegs bu'i khar maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris la lte bar tshom bu sngon po dang*/ 'dab ma rnams su klu'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i tshom bu re 'god/ de'i mthar rdo rje shugs sde drug srung ma drug cu dang bcas pa'i gtor ma/ khyad par yul bdag dang*/ sgos kyi chos skyong gi gtong ma dang*/ klu bshos klu sman sbyar ba'i gtor ma sogs dang*/ mchod pa bcu gnyis rnams bsham/ rang nyid kha shar ram byang du phyogs pas rdo rje shugs kyi sgrub thabs bsgom/ bzlas pa'i skabs su sngags phreng las 'od zer zla 'od lta bu spros/ klu'i rigs su gyur pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bde dga' thob nas char chen po 'bebs pa dang*/ 'od zer des sems can spyi dang*/ bye brag tu than pa'i 'bras bu myong 'gyur gyi sems can la phog pas/ de dag ni sdig sgrib las ngan rnams sbyong ba dang*/ yang 'od zer 'phros te char 'bebs pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs dang*/ sprin 'thor bar byed pa'i rlung lha'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i 'byung po rnams kyi ngan sems zhi nas mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa bya/ de nas mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsangs la/ rdo rje shugs klu bcu dang bcas pa langs stabs su bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug pa dang dbang bskur ba rnams bya/ slar yang sde drug srung ma drug cu'i tshogs spyan drangs te*/ de'i mthar 'khod par bsams la/ mchod pa dang bstod pas bstod/ gtor ma phul/ khyad par rdo rje shugs klu'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ yul de'i lha la sger gyis gtor ma bsngos la phrin las bcol/ de nas bzlas pa gong bzhin las khro bo bskul ba'i sngags bzlas pas/ khro bo bcus bka' bsgos/ zad par rnams kyis 'byung ba'i bcud nyams pa gsos/ phyogs skyong bcus rlung mnan cing sprin sdud/ gza' bcus char 'bebs pa la myur pa'i las byed klu bcus lto ba nas sprin phyung 'brug gi skad 'byin cing char 'bebs/

rab gtum ma bcus than pa gtong ba'i bgegs skrod pa sogs byed par bsams la/ sngags spel tshig can drag tu bzla bar bya'o// tshul de lta bus char ma babs na rang dang mdun bskyed tha mi dad du byas te/ rdo rje shugs sku shin tu che ba ri rab tsam gyi zhabs 'og tu klu'i gtso bo gnyis mnan/ gzhan rnams pad 'dab la bsgyel nas mjug ma zhabs 'og tu mnan la/ klu de rnams la dgug gzhug byas te bstim/ gtso bo'i zhal dang phyag mtshan rnams las me'i tshwa tshwa 'phros/ klu rnams la phog pas gzir zhing bka' bsgo ba'i tshul du sngags drag tu bzlas pas gdon mi za bar char 'bebs so// mdun bskyed gshegs su gsol ba dang klu btang ba kho nas char chad par gsungs te/ de'i phyir thun mthar yang mdun gyi rdo rje shugs la brtan bzhugs dang klu 'ching ba'i phrin las bcol/ rang mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du langs la spyod lam la 'jug go /spyir char 'bebs pa'i las gang la yang gza' rnams sa chu'i khams la spyod pa shas che na 'bebs sla/ me rlung sogs su zhugs na phebs dka' zhing*/ phebs kyang ser ba sogs su 'gro bas gza' skar la blta ba gal che zhing*/ rgyud 'di nyid las klu dang rab gtum ma rnams lus bsam gyi tshul du gsungs pas/ 'byung po bcu las la bskul ba shin tu gces so// gnyis pa thog dang ser ba srung ba la ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i sgo nas srung na srung 'khor rgyas par bsgoms te/ de tsam ma lcogs na'ang rang nyid rdo rje shugs su bsgoms nas sngags bzlas pa tsam gyis thog bsrung bar nus la/ yang nam mkha' la mdzub mos thog ris zur lnga gling drug sngags dang bcas pa dpe'u chung ltar 'bri ba'i tshul byas la/ rang gi mgo thog mde'u zur lnga gling drug me rab tu 'bar ba sngags dang bcas pa bsgom/ oṃ ta k+ṣa ta bam̐/ zhes bdun tsam bzlas pas thog bsrung bar 'gyur ro// gzhan la srung ba ster na'ang shog bur bris te dri bzang dang bdud rtsi ril bu byugs la rdo rje shugs kyi sngags bzla zhing rab gnas bgyis te dril la bcangs pas thog thub bo// ser ba srung na rang nyid rdo rje shugs su gsal ba'i lte bar li las 'byung po bcu dpag tu med pa spros te ser ba phyogs gzhan du bskrad par bsams la sngags bzla/

phus 'debs/ de bzhin du snying gar u las klu dang*/ mgrin par ṛ las gza' dang*/ dpral par i las phyogs skyong rnams spros nas bsrung ngo*// de las gzhan pa'i thog dang ser ba srung tshul mang du yod mod kyi 'dir ma bkod do// gsum pa lus srung gi 'khor lo bsten tshul ni/ ras sam dar la 'bri ba'am/ ma 'byor na shog bu la bris kyang rung 'khor lo dpe'u chung ltar mu khyud bcu gcig gis bskor ba'i phyi

(ri mo zhig 'dug pas dgongs 'jag 'tshal/) ma la rdo rwa me ri bri/ de'i nang ma la rten 'brel 1 snying po g.yas skor du 'bri/ de'i nang ma la gas 2 la byed dang*/ de'i nang ma la dbya 4 ngas dang*/ de'i nang gi mu khyud bzhin rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par rim pa bzhin nag po dang dmar po dang dkar po dang ser po bzhis bskor ba/ de'i nang zla ba dkar po/ nyi ma dmar po/ sgra gcan nag po sum brtsegs kyi lte bar tsheg drag can gyi ham̐ḥyig bkod/ rten 'brel snying po'i mjug tu/ 'chang ba la steng gdon gza' skar dus sbyor sgra gcan gyi gnod pa/ bar gdon rgyal btsan gri bo sogs sde brgyad 'byung po'i gnod pa/ 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gnod pa thams cad srungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā bri/ rdo rje shugs kyi nga rgyal gyis srung ma drug cur gtor ma byin te bka' bsgos la 'khor lo rdo rje shugs su bskyed nas 'od zhu bya/ sngags bzla zhing rab gnas byas te srad bu lngas dkris/ dar dmar sogs lkog dmar po btab la mgul du btags pas steng 'og bar gsum gyi gnod pa thams cad la shin tu phan no// spyir srung ma drug cu'i lha re re'i sgo nas kyang las sna tshogs bsgrub tu yod pa rnams 'grel chen las sgrol ma'i sngags la dper brjod mdzad pa lta bus rtogs par nus mod/ 'dir thun mong ba grags tshod ltar sgo tsam zhig smos so// de ltar khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs// gang gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs bcas// dam pas bskul phyir blo gsal ri khrod pas// rgyud 'grel bla ma'i gsung bzhin yi ger bkod// de yi dge bas mtha' yas 'gro ba rnams// bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa las grol te// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba chen po yi// lam bzang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'grub gyur cig /ces pa'i 'di yang rje btsun mchog gi sprul ba'i sku 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i bkas bskul ba la brten btsun pa blo gsal bstan skyong gis/

sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi phyag len jo zhal gnyis las brgyud pa'i yig rnying dang*/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub kyi yi ge sogs las don gyi legs cha blangs shing*/ rgyud 'grel dang man ngag gis zhus dag par byas te/ thun mong gi lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang po gnyis pa la gdan sa chen po zhwa lu ri phug gi sgrub khang rnam grol yang rtser bris pa'o// 'dis kyang 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po myur du skem par gyur cig/ // (dkyil 'khor ri mo zhig yod pas dgong 'jag 'tshal//) ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
